notes.title: Thank You for Playing! Updates and Fixes Coming Soon
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]I just wanted to take a moment to say a huge thank you to everyone who has played my game so far.[/p][p]I’ve been reading all of your feedback and paying close attention to bug reports. I want you to know that I’m actively working on fixes and improvements to make the game even better. Expect some updates soon as I roll them out.[/p][p]Here are a few things to expect from the next update:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed some grammar mistakes on the notes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed note 9 and 10 duplicate text[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new hint note for the piano Puzzle[/p][/*][*][p]other minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback really helps shape the game, so please keep it coming! [/p][p]Thank you again for playing.[/p][p]Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Game is out now!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b]
The game is now out and available for everyone to play![/p][p]I hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoyed developing it. I’m looking forward to seeing your gameplay videos and reading all your feedback. If you play it, don’t forget to leave a rating and a comment to let me know what you think. Also, feel free to share any suggestions for improvements or changes.[/p][p][b]Cheers![/b][/p]

notes.title: Game releasing tomorrow!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!
I am happy to announce that the game is ready to be released sometime tomorrow![/p][p]Looking forward to hear what you think about the game.[/p][p][/p][p]See you then![/p]

notes.title: Game is coming very soon!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661881/a713bbc30c27569b1d4b8fe5b652086a1f2aaeb3.jpg"][/img]Hello everyone![/p][p]I just wanted to give you all a small update on the development of the game. I’ve been a little bit quiet since I published the Steam page, as I’ve been really busy polishing the game and making sure it works as intended.[/p][p]I can now say with confidence that the game is ready, and you won’t have to wait much longer. I don’t have an exact release date yet, but if everything goes as planned, I’m aiming to release it in September.[/p][p]In the meantime, here are some screenshots from the latest build of the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661881/d7c1bb071f1f49277395150244c252d34e32451e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661881/7b312fb5b55910b6a9597e7bcbcc0ee962457378.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I’m looking forward to hearing what everyone thinks about it.[/p][p]Cheers![/p]
